title: Resolution urging Albany to fund youth sports from betting revenue
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to set aside a portion of state sports betting revenue to support youth sports programs, upgrade community sports infrastructure and expand access to recreational athletics statewide. It notes that New York earned $184.5 million in sports betting revenue in February 2025 alone and is projected to exceed $1 billion in 2025, far outpacing the $15 million the state spent on youth sports in 2024. It cites research showing declining youth sports participation and inequities between low-income and wealthy families.
